text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spot Tamamo Cross before she starts
training. I
think I hear her sniffling,
though...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ack! What da heck are you doin' here?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
O-oh... this snifflin' is uh—I got hay
fever! What
else could it be?! Ya never
heard of allergies?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Uh, this? Just some regular ol' tissue
paper.
Y'know, for wipin' the ol' sniffer...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No, ya dolt! Just see what happens if ya
do!
choice_data_list: Shall I toss this out for you?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Nothin' gets past you, huh! I was just
readin' a fan
letter's all!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever I see you zipping past the
bigger
racers like lightning..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"It gives me courage." That's what they
said.
Readin' this stuff gives me the
fuzzies...
